scope: Additive C receiving-context research; A rushing and B QB/personalization ownership preserved. No original-production writes or automatic primary switch.
source_first: Inspect existing facts/PBP and public nflverse/nflreadr definitions. Project only qualified ordinary factual columns; no protected FTN/NGS redistribution. Actual route/alignment tests remain blocked without full route denominators.
new_hypothesis: Earlier target depth/down mixture and opponent residual response may add information beyond player-game opportunity history. This is not the closed target-share slope, team-completion-rate, NGS, allocation or calibration recipe.

arms.E0: Unchanged retained H-MULTI P3_HGB/E0_OP exact-line reference where recoverable; typed retained Leaf mean/median/law also retained.
arms.E1: Same monotone HGB learner plus earlier player/team target depth/down/distance and support; targets per official team attempt, not per route.
arms.E2: E1 plus shrunk opponent-context residual main effects adjusted against offense quality available before each prior game.
arms.E3: E2 plus a small fixed set of predicted own-mix x opponent-context effects; no realized target-game mixture.

personalization.coordination: B coordinates shared specification; C owns only its receiver fits. No cross-owner duplicate fits.
personalization.P0: Strong unchanged retained football law/direct reference
personalization.P1: Pooled contextual count regression with the same E2 feature set
personalization.P2: Same contextual Poisson model with jointly trained L2-regularized player/team/defense intercepts; unseen effects zero, not hindsight routing. No in-sample upstream predictions.
personalization.P3: Player-only empirical count law on eight earlier known appearances, minimum eight; P1 fallback otherwise. Common-supported and full-system records separate.
personalization.status: Declared bounded C comparator; no claim B specification received
personalization.execution_scope: 2026W1-W8 two fits per origin;2025 personalization remains queue; no duplicate B fit

history: 2022-expanding ordinary football training; new play context only where projected 2025/2026 sources qualify. Eligibility first at kickoff+7days strictly before each origin, then last games by game time and native identity. Current-vintage reconstruction, not authenticated original availability.
lookback: Initial fixed 8 earlier player appearances/team games, with 4/16 as a separately measured earlier-only development menu before any use in a later version. No claim 8 is optimal.

periods.actual_offer_panel: Previously admitted immutable Pinnacle W2-W3 exact lines; all 362 rec offers preserved; missing native identities unavailable
periods.older: 2022-2024/full2025 queue; actual context/offer coverage must be demonstrated, not inferred from training

frozen_policy: All eligible offers; probability direction chooses larger exact-line Under/Over with equality abstain; points retain mean/median typing. Existing exploratory Top6/10/20 rules only; no new selective threshold/90% claim.
stop_rules: Cache only exact-compatible completed fits; persist attempts/failures before retry. No overwriting original fits/forecasts. Stop at real caps; no broad learner/seed/feature search.
practical_review_threshold: Existing C 1 percentage-point matched direction or 0.005 Brier descriptive review threshold; not scientific qualification or primary admission
verification: Independent read-only checks of identities/denominators, eligible prefixes, future/target mutation invariance, exact-line probabilities/complements/monotonicity, own-side counts, fallback/common masks, representative wins/losses and fresh GitHub restoration
five_week_rule: Exact product/procedure/role/policy needs five distinct scored season-weeks plus existing support/source/operational gates; no automatic promotion
